formValues.onboarding-summary: The application proposes boxed desk organizers delivered to the central receiving location. The supplier coordinator reports consistent trading-name and account-holder records and no duplicate supplier. A sample matched the buying brief. Final delivery charges and damaged-delivery terms remain unresolved. The category buyer proposes two trial deliveries; no orders have been authorized.
